votes.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.staff_id,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS complaints_this_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed' AND c.complaint_outcome_code = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes_this_year
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999
    GROUP BY c.staff_id, year
)
SELECT
    staff_id,
    year,
    SUM(complaints_this_year) OVER (PARTITION BY staff_id ORDER BY year
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_complaint_count,
    CASE WHEN complaints_this_year = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE successes_this_year * 1.0 / complaints_this_year END AS annual_resolution_success_rate
FROM yearly
ORDER BY staff_id, year;

SELECT 
    c.staff_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
AND strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1999'
GROUP BY c.staff_id, strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised)
ORDER BY c.staff_id, year;

WITH hw_complaints AS (
    SELECT
        c.staff_id,
        strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.complaint_outcome_code = 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_complaints
    FROM Complaints c
    JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
      AND strftime('%Y', c.date_complaint_raised) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1999'
    GROUP BY c.staff_id, year
),
annual_stats AS (
    SELECT
        staff_id,
        year,
        total_complaints,
        successful_complaints,
        CASE WHEN total_complaints = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE CAST(successful_complaints AS REAL) / total_complaints END AS success_rate
    FROM hw_complaints
)
SELECT
    staff_id,
    year,
    SUM(total_complaints) OVER (PARTITION BY staff_id ORDER BY year
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_complaint_count,
    success_rate
FROM annual_stats
ORDER BY staff_id, year;
